caption: Flo steps into the kitchen: cook it, plate it, serve it - one pair of hands, all stations.

req.note: 2003-2011 casual 2d, single-digit-to-double-digit-megabytes install. runs on anything, including hardware far below the target bar.

links.official_note: still sold on steam ($9.99) - one of the dash universe's surviving official doors. the archive routes below ride along for the original-era builds.

about: Cooking Dash, released for windows in 2008 with development by Aliasworlds Entertainment under the PlayFirst banner, changes the protagonist's job rather than the protagonist: Flo drops the trays and takes the stove, cooking every order herself while Grandma runs the seating.

The design consequence is real - the chain now runs through preparation stations, so a wrong sequencing decision at the grill costs more than a wrong seating choice ever did. Multi-course meals, celebrity customers and kitchen upgrades carry the fifty-level campaign, and two players can still share one pc.
The build reached steam on 12 august 2009 as part of playfirst's store batch and that listing still sells it - one of the few official doors left into the Dash universe.
